utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, I’m setting up the repair drive this Saturday on my front porch and could use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Sam. I can help out on Saturday and I’ll bring a few extra hands if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’m in. I can also ask a couple neighbors to help out so we have a solid crew on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help for a bit on Saturday. Just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — could you come by around 9 on Saturday morning at the front porch? That should help me keep the logistics on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help me out this Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help out Saturday. Just remind me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik — I’ll count on you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina. I’ll be on the front porch Saturday and could still use a couple more helpers if you know anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday at your front porch—I’d be glad to help if I can. Just remind me what time you need me there, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and let you know so we can get the helpers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help for a bit on Saturday. Just tell me what you need me to do on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Uli. I’ll let Tess know you’re in, and I’ll see if I can round up one or two more helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I’m still trying to line up enough helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so if you can lend a hand, that would really help with the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I can help on Saturday. Just let me know what time to be there and what you need me to do.
